medicalHistory.title: Rabies 3-Year & DHPP Booster
medicalHistory.summary: Annual wellness visit. Administered Nobivac 3-year rabies and DHPP booster. Patient tolerated both injections well.

medicalHistory.title: Otitis Externa (Left Ear)
medicalHistory.summary: Mild erythema and discharge in the left ear canal. Cytology showed cocci. Started on ear cleaner and topical drops for 10 days.

medicalHistory.title: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
medicalHistory.summary: Routine screening. Liver and kidney values within normal limits. Mildly elevated cholesterol, diet review recommended.

medicalHistory.title: Seasonal Atopic Dermatitis
medicalHistory.summary: Presented with moderate itching and redness on paws and belly. No signs of infection. Prescribed Apoquel for 14 days and transitioned to sensitive skin diet.

medicalHistory.title: Routine Spay / Ovariohysterectomy
medicalHistory.summary: Procedure completed without complications. Pre-anesthetic blood work within normal limits. Post-op recovery in clinic was excellent.

medicalHistory.title: Rabies 3-Year & DHPP Booster
medicalHistory.summary: Standard annual wellness check. Administered Nobivac 3-yr Rabies and DHPP booster. Patient behaved well.

medicalHistory.title: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
medicalHistory.summary: Pre-surgical screening. ALT and ALP levels normal. Kidney function (BUN/Creatinine) within range. WBC count normal.

medicalHistory.title: Suspected Metabolic Bone Disease
medicalHistory.summary: Mild softening of the jaw and reluctance to climb. Reptile panel ordered. Started calcium supplementation and reviewed UVB exposure schedule.

medicalHistory.title: Fecal Float & Direct Smear
medicalHistory.summary: No parasites detected. Moderate flagellate load noted, consistent with diet change. Recheck in 8 weeks if symptoms persist.

medicalHistory.title: Husbandry Review — UVB & Calcium
medicalHistory.summary: Discussed enclosure temperatures, UVB bulb replacement cycle and dusted feeder schedule. Client to keep a feeding log.

medicalHistory.title: Leptospirosis Booster
medicalHistory.summary: Annual booster administered. No adverse reaction observed during the 30-minute post-vaccine observation period.

medicalHistory.title: Osteoarthritis — Early Stage
medicalHistory.summary: Mild stiffness after exercise and reduced willingness to jump. Started joint supplement and 30-minute leash walks; recheck in 3 months.

medicalHistory.title: Thyroid Panel (T4)
medicalHistory.summary: T4 within reference range. No evidence of hypothyroidism. Repeat only if clinical signs develop.

medicalHistory.title: Foreign Body Ingestion — Gastritis
medicalHistory.summary: Presented with acute vomiting after ingesting a sock. Radiographs confirmed gastric foreign material. Admitted for endoscopy and overnight observation.

medicalHistory.title: Endoscopic Foreign Body Removal
medicalHistory.summary: Foreign material retrieved endoscopically without incision. Recovered in clinic for 6 hours and discharged same day with bland diet.

medicalHistory.title: DHPP Series Completion
medicalHistory.summary: Final puppy DHPP booster administered. Rabies given at the same visit. Mild injection-site soreness reported the next day.
